Body.Content:
Spend less time manually adding attendees to meal-related business expenses. Expense Agent can match the expense to the relevant Outlook calendar event and add invited guests as expense participants, helping keep participant information aligned with the meeting invitation.

Benefits

• Automatically identifies relevant Outlook calendar meetings when expense participants are required.

• Retrieves invited attendees from the matching calendar invitation.

• Adds invited guests as expense participants without manual entry.

GA date: April CY2027

Preview date: January CY2027
